title: Early Renewal Percentage for TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Repeat Orders
content:
Repeat-order lead schedule: a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours repeat order placed while the current block still has at least 90 calendar days to its expiry date earns 1 percent, one placed with at least 30 and fewer than 90 days left earns 0.5 percent, and one placed later earns none. Days are counted from the order date to the expiry date, the order date not counted. The percentage is granted to the repeat-order price.

| Days from the order date to the current block's expiry date | Percentage |
|---|---|
| 90 or more | 1 |
| 30 to 89 | 0.5 |
| fewer than 30, or the expiry date already passed | none |

Hypothetical cases for a current block expiring 30 September: an order on 2 July leaves 90 days and earns 1 percent; an order on 3 July leaves 89 days and earns 0.5 percent; an order on 31 August leaves 30 days and earns 0.5 percent; an order on 1 September leaves 29 days and earns none.
